z-m-39-01.title: Qiyamo kala duwan ma yeelan karaan isla wadar?
z-m-39-01.topic: Macnaha shaqada iyo shaqooyinka hal-hal: shuruud wadar ah oo qiyamka ah iyo cabbirka koodh-aagga
z-m-39-01.goal: Isticmaal tusaale lid ku ah si aad u xaqiijiso in macnaha shaqo hal-hal ah (xubno kala duwan waxay u dhigmaan qiyamo kala duwan) uusan waxba ka sheegin wadarrada qiyamka, oo sharax in haddii shaqo leh isla shuruud jirto ay ku xiran tahay koodh-aagga.
z-m-39-01.material: Ka fikir shaqo f oo laga bilaabo aagga X={1, 2, 3, 4} ilaa koodh-aagga Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7} sidii jadwal qiyamo. Jadwalku wuxuu taxayaa f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) oo keliya (qaacido ma jirto). Shuruudda (가): f waa shaqo hal-hal ah, taasi waa, xubno kala duwan oo X waxay u dhigmaan qiyamo kala duwan. Shuruudda (나): f(1)+f(4)=f(2)+f(3). Mina wuxuu yiri, “Haddii ay tahay hal-hal, afarta qiimood dhammaantood waa kala duwan yihiin. Markaas wadarrada laba lammaane ma noqon karaan le'eg sida (나).”
z-m-39-01.thinking.0: U wareejinta sheegashada jadwal qiyamo iyo tijaabinteeda
z-m-39-01.thinking.1: Dhisidda tusaalayaal kala duwan (tusaalayaal lid ku ah) oo buuxiya shuruudaha
z-m-39-01.thinking.2: Si shuruud leh u go'aaminta haddii shaqo sidaas ah jirto marka koodh-aagga isbeddelo
z-m-39-01.prereq.0: Macnaha shaqo, aag, koodh-aag, iyo xad, iyo macnaha shaqo hal-hal ah (qaybta hore ee cutubka shaqooyinka ee Xisaabta Guud dugsiga sare)
z-m-39-01.prereq.2: (Malo-awaalka isku xigga dugsiga: H2 ee hawshan waa summad adkaan oo soo saarista lagu bixiyay oo keliya, waxaana loo malaynayaa shuruudaha hore horeyba la bartay.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro go'aankaaga ugu horreeya ee hadalka Mina. (Uma baahnid inaad weli xisaabiso.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) sidii afar meel madhan, oo buuxi afar lambar oo kala duwan.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.1: Lambarrada aad buuxisay, si gooni ah qor f(1)+f(4) iyo f(2)+f(3) oo is barbar dhig haddii ay le'eg yihiin.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.a: Sax. Haddii dhammaan afarta qiimood ay kala duwan yihiin, wadarrada labada lammaane sidoo kale way kala duwan yihiin
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad isku mid u daawanaysaa “qiyamku waa kala duwan yihiin” iyo “wadarradu waa kala duwan yihiin”. Dooro laba lammaane oo lambarro kala duwan adigu oo is barbar dhig wadarrada.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.b: Sax. Shaqo hal-hal ah ayaa weyn noqota marka x weynaado, sidaas darteed wadarrada ma noqon karaan le'eg
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad isku mid u daawanaysaa shaqo hal-hal ah iyo shaqo kordhaysa. Ka fikir haddii ay jiraan shaqooyin hal-hal ah oo qiyamkoodu yaraado.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.c: Khalad. Xataa haddii dhammaan qiyamku kala duwan yihiin, wadarrada laba lammaane oo kala duwan way le'eg yihiin karaan
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad u akhridday sheegashada sida “had iyo jeer” oo waxaad shakisay haddii tusaale jiro. Hadda waa waqtigii lagu tijaabin lahaa haddii tusaale sidaas ah runtii la dhisi karo.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.d: Ma go'aamin karno. Waa sababtoo ah qaacidada f lama bixin
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ka fikiraysaa shaqo qaacido oo keliya. Halkan, jadwalka afarta qiimood oo keliya ayaa ku filan in lagu tijaabiyo shuruudaha.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.explain: Shuruudda ah in la noqdo shaqo hal-hal ah waxay sheegtaa oo keliya in afarta qiimood ay kala duwan yihiin. Haddii wadarrada laba lammaane ay le'eg yihiin xataa marka afarta qiimood ay kala duwan yihiin waa in lagu hubiyaa adigoo runtii heleya tusaale. Aan ku tijaabinno tallaabada xigta.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.prompt: Adoo jadwal qiyamo isticmaalaya, samee 2 shaqo f oo buuxiya labadaba shuruudaha (가) iyo (나) oo f(1) uu ka weyn yahay f(2). Labada shaqo waa inay isticmaalaan kooxo qiyamo ah oo kala duwan. (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), d=f(4); dhammaan tirooyin dhan oo ka bilaabma 1 ilaa 7)
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel koox afar lambar oo kala duwan ah oo f(1)+f(4) iyo f(2)+f(3) ay le'eg yihiin.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dhig afarta lambar ee aad heshay si f(1) uu uga weynaado f(2), oo mar kale hubi in labada wadar ay weli le'eg yihiin.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.2: Hel hal koox oo kale oo lambarradiisu laftooda ay ka duwan yihiin kuwa shaqada koowaad lagu isticmaalay.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Dhammaan afarta qiimood waa xubno ka mid ah koodh-aagga Y (tirooyin dhan oo ka bilaabma 1 ilaa 7).
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Qiime kasta waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan oo ka bilaabma 1 ilaa 7.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Dhammaan afarta qiimood waa kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed waa shaqo hal-hal ah.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Isla qiime ayaa laba jeer la isticmaalay. Ma aha shaqo hal-hal ah.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c4: f(1) wuu ka weyn yahay f(2).
z-m-39-01.s.s2.explain: Tusaale ahaan, (3, 1, 6, 4) wuxuu leeyahay 3+4=7=1+6 afarta qiimood-na dhammaantood waa kala duwan yihiin. Sidaas darteed sheegashada Mina ma sax ahan. Sidoo kale, maadaama uu jiro tusaale leh f(1)>f(2), shaqo hal-hal ah ma sii qaabeeyo qiimo weyn oo keliya. ((1, 2, 3, 4) wuxuu buuxiyaa shuruudda wadarta laakiin wuxuu jebiyaa f(1)>f(2), sidaas darteed tallaabadan lagama aqbalo.)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.prompt: Macluumaad cusub: aagga wuxuu sii jiraa X={1, 2, 3, 4} shuruudaha (가) iyo (나) sidooda ayay sii jiraan, laakiin koodh-aagga Y waa la beddelay sida hoose. Dooro dhammaan koodh-aagyada laga samayn karo shaqo f buuxisa shuruudaha. (Shuruudda f(1)>f(2) ma jirto.)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.0: Koodh-aag kasta, dooro afar lambar oo kala duwan, u kala qaybi laba lammaane, oo qor wadarrada labada lammaane isbarbar.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.1: Haddii koodh-aagga uu leeyahay wax ka yar 4 xubnood, marka hore tiri si aad u hubiso haddii shaqo hal-hal ah la samayn karo gabi ahaanba.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.a: Waxay u muuqataa inaad u maleysay in 5 xubnood ay aad u ku filan yihiin. Dooro afar ka mid ah, u kala qaybi laba lammaane, oo adigu qor haddii ay jirto xaalad wadarrada ay le'eg yihiin.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad eegtay ma aha tirada xubnaha oo keliya laakiin sidoo kale xaqiiqda ah in lambarradu si siman u kala fogaadaan. Hubi haddii aad heshay laba lammaane oo wadarro le'eg leh.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.c: Haddii aad marka hore eegto shuruudda wadarta, way fududahay in la seego inaan xubno ku filan jirin. Marka hore tiri imisa qiimood ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo noqdo shaqo hal-hal ah.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad hubisay haddii koodh-aag isku cabbir ah aagga uu sidoo kale leeyahay laba lammaane oo wadarro le'eg leh. Waxaad tixgelisay xaaladda afarta lambar ay dhammaantood la isticmaalo.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.explain: {1,2,3} wuxuu leeyahay 3 xubnood oo keliya, sidaas darteed afarta xubnood ee X ma yeelan karaan qiimo kala duwan, shaqo hal-hal ahna ma jirto gabi ahaanba. {1,2,3,4} wuxuu leeyahay 1+4=2+3, {2,5,8,11,14} na wuxuu leeyahay laba lammaane oo wadarro le'eg leh sida 2+14=5+11. {1,2,4,8,16} wuxuu leeyahay 5 xubnood, laakiin ma jirto xaalad wadarrada laba lammaane oo kala duwan ay le'eg yihiin. Ma aha in xubno badan ay ku filan yihiin; lambarrada ay yihiin ayaa muhiim ah.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.prompt: U sharax Mina. Qor (1) halka sheegashada asalka ahi ay ku khaldan tahay, adigoo tusaale lambar ah isticmaalaya, iyo (2) in shaqo leh isla shuruudaha ayan had iyo jeer jirin, adigoo koodh-aag isticmaalaya.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.0: Qaado mid ka mid ah jadwalada aad ka samaysay tallaabada 2 sida uu yahay, oo qor afarta qiimood iyo labada wadar.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.1: Dooro hal koodh-aag aadan ka dooran tallaabada 3, oo hal weedh ku qor sababta shaqo aan looga samayn karin koodh-aagga.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.placeholder: Tusaale: Shaqo hal-hal ah macnaheedu waa ..., laakiin ...
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Tusaalahaaga lambarka, ma cadahay in afarta qiimood ay dhammaantood kala duwan yihiin wadarrada labada lammaane-na ay le'eg yihiin?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saartay waxa “hal-hal ah” noo sheego iyo waxa aanu noo sheegin?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ma bixisay tusaalayaal (xaalad xubno aad u yar leh, ama xaalad aan lahayn lammaanayaal wadarro le'eg leh) oo muujinaya in iyadoo ku xiran koodh-aagga shaqo laga yaabo inay jirto ama aysan jirin?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.0: Afar qiimood oo kala duwan ayaa wali yeelan kara wadarro le'eg. Tusaale ahaan, haddii f(1)=3, f(2)=1, f(3)=6, f(4)=4, markaas qiyamku dhammaantood waa kala duwan yihiin 3+4=1+6=7-na. Laakiin haddii koodh-aagga uu yahay urur sida {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, kaas oo aan lahayn laba lammaane oo wadarro le'eg leh, shaqo sidaas ah lama samayn karo.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.1: Shaqo hal-hal ah macnaheedu waa kaliya qiyamku isma dul saaran, ma aha in wadarradu kala duwan yihiin. Haddii f(1)=2, f(2)=1, f(3)=4, f(4)=3, markaas 2+3=1+4=5, sidaas darteed wadarradu way le'eg yihiin. Laakiin haddii koodh-aagga uu leeyahay 3 xubnood oo keliya, xataa shaqo hal-hal ah ma jirto, sidaas darteed iyadoo ku xiran urur noocee ah ayuu koodh-aagga yahay, shaqo ayaa laga yaabaa inay jirto ama aysan jirin.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Ma sheegin haddii qiyamku kordhayaan, laakiin wuxuu leeyahay labadaba tusaalaha lid ku ah iyo shuruudda koodh-aagga.
